steps.content:
December 9, N.F. 114
16:30
MBCC Chief's Office
Your invited guest arrives right on schedule.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's rare you call to see me, Chief. Has there been any progress in the cabinet attack investigation?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: I heard you were attacked right after finishing your investigation at the FAC. Did you see who did it?

options: I thought you'd ask about my injuries first.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Sure. How are you feeling? You've done so well. Wishing you a speedy recovery.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Alright, just kidding. I'll handle those attackers later. They're not our main concern right now, and this isn't my first injury, anyways.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I called you here because I've found something else... something interesting.
You slide the documents across the desk to Schorl.

Internal Memo 114-BM-10.14.01 Eastside Public Security Bureau Primary Candidate: Maurice Ford. Handover process arranged; public announcement scheduled for January 6, N.F. 115. Note: Following negotiations with the Ford family, former Deputy Chief Simpson of the Public Security Bureau has entered legal investigation proceedings. Bureau of Commerce and Trade Due to continued growth in Outland trade volume, the previous candidate recommended by the Harringtons requires further review. Make sure the candidate aligns with the new circumstances. Bureau of Energy and Industry Primary Candidate: Joseph Carlton. Handover completed; public announcement scheduled for January 15, N.F. 115. Candidate remains endorsed by House Jacknal, no objections noted.

Internal Memo 114-BM-10.14.02 Hypercube Regulatory Bureau Primary Candidate: Alexander Green, transferring from Nirvana Public Affairs Office as per protocol. Preliminary tasks successfully completed, news press scheduled for March 1, N.F. 115. Outland Affairs Bureau Primary Candidate: Retention of Guillotin deemed necessary; unanimous agreement on maintaining current appointment. Revision Note (11/28): Guillotin is currently in recovery; discussions regarding a potential replacement are ongoing; low priority. Bureau of Agricultural Reserves Recommended Candidate: Erin Hopkins. Work handover completed; public announcement scheduled for February 20, N.F. 115. The candidate is jointly nominated by satellite towns. Revision Note (11/28): Satellite towns' nomination rejected; appointment authority transferred to the Stewart family.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Interesting, isn't it? The cabinet was massacred, with almost all senior officials killed. Despite such a significant event, looking at it now... it seems to have barely impacted the city's operations.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: New appointees were immediately put in place, stepping into the exact roles of their predecessors, backed by the same behind-the-scenes support, and continuing policies that align with the same interests.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Here's what's even more intriguing: the cabinet lineup is already set in stone before we've even elected the next leader. Even if they've sealed the deal of Bernadette Cavendish's win, this is still way too confident of them, don't you think?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...Who provided you with this information?

options: The source no longer matters, doesn't it?
That being asked, so it's true?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This supposed "most important civic event" turns out to be nothing but a facade, a circus act. These unseen voters are the real ones determining their next leader, while the public election is just there to rubber-stamp their decision.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bernadette's image as an independent force standing against her predecessor was simply a show put on for the voters, intended only to attract more votes from those in opposition.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm finally starting to get it...

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: The threat has diminished. No one's in jeopardy, and the culprit has been cautioned. They are unlikely to act again.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: But if you press on, they may think of it as a declaration of war. What do you think they would do then?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In this election, in this city, there are influences that I can hardly make out. The council, even the whole cabinet, are nothing but their puppets, the citizens just an audience they've carefully crafted. It's all a recurring drama staged every four years, where real change is forever out of reach.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I guess I had it coming for poking my nose where it didn't belong and breaking the rules recklessly. Getting away with just these wounds... I should count myself lucky.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But what part does Paradeisos play in all of this? Is this truly the governance you envision for Eastside?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...All I can say is that things haven't spiraled out of control for now. This solution, while not ideal, still falls within acceptable boundaries.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We understand the injustice you've endured. With the EDGE's computing power strained by fighting the calamity, we can't allocate resources to fully protect you, nor can we precisely control every variable in the city. Many wield power and violence, yet few possess the wisdom to master either.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: That's why we urged you to steer clear in caution and avoid delving too deeply. Under normal circumstances, we wouldn't task you with such responsibilities during an election season, but reality often presents complexities beyond our plans.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Considering the unfolding events, we will set things right for you. All hostilities directed towards you will cease, and we hope you will regard this matter as closed.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Paradeisos doesn't want to see any further harm come your way, nor do we want you to be under detrimental influences. You have a more important mission to fulfill.
There might be some sincerity in those words, but you can never truly discern the genuineness of emotions from a machine.
—And a discussion within Paradeisos is not your real purpose anyway.

options: I'll decide my next steps for myself.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But there seems to be a misunderstanding. I didn't approach you today to file a complaint.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: As I promised, my sole mission is to investigate, to uncover the truth behind a major Mania attack and murder case.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Whether this has anything to do with the election or not, the intricate power dynamics at play, or what hornets' nest I've stirred up, my only focus is the perpetrator—their motives, and what exactly are they playing along the way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now, with these leaked insider details in hand, I finally see a possibility that may crack this case open.
Your finger points to a name on the list.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This one is...

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ! Does it mean that...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Everyone keeps saying that I'm too obsessed with trivial investigations, unable to see the full picture of the election, while the true power players sit in elevated positions, pulling all the strings.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But now it seems those supposedly "inscrutable" figures, absorbed in their political games for decades, might be the ones with a limited perspective, unable to see beyond their own chessboard.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Perhaps... they've already been thoroughly fooled by the very people they deem worthless.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: ...So, you already have a suspect in mind.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...Yes, I have my suspicions, but they still need to be verified.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I just want this to proceed according to my plan.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Very well. You've managed this exceptionally well, after all. You can proceed as you wish.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: We have only one condition: your security detail must be enhanced, with Paradeisos overseeing the arrangements. We don't wish to see a recurrence of the past incident, and we don't trust your judgment when it comes to your own safety.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...There are others who need protection more than I do.

Jelena opens her eyes. Instead of her familiar ward, she finds herself in a room adorned with advanced medical apparatus, cozy furnishings, and thoughtful get-well presents and bouquets from the Bureau personnel...
She appears to be under a heightened level of care, yet Elvira, typically inseparable from her, is nowhere to be seen.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Oh! You're finally awake! Everyone's been so worried about you. How are you feeling? Any discomfort anywhere?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Thank you, I'm feeling fine... May I ask where Miss Stewart is?

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Oh, Chief said that sticking around you might pose a risk of Mania infection, so he had Hecate escort her back. For your own safety, he has stationed additional guards, saying he's worried about your health.
steps.female_content: Oh, Chief said that sticking around you might pose a risk of Mania infection, so she had Hecate escort her back. For your own safety, she has stationed additional guards, saying she's worried about your health.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...I see. He's as reliable as ever.
steps.female_content: ...I see. She's as reliable as ever.

steps.content: Jelena casts a casual glance out the window.
As she notices several security personnel discreetly positioned outside, a wave of unexpected relief washes over her. A smile even unconsciously forms on her lips.
That Chief truly proves to be reliable.

steps.speaker: Nurse
steps.content: Now that you're awake, I'll notify Chief right away. He's been really concerned about you, checking in constantly.
steps.female_content: Now that you're awake, I'll notify Chief right away. She's been really concerned about you, checking in constantly.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Thank you. You truly are kind people.
And yet... can someone so seemingly kind really be trusted?

Elvira opens her eyes to find herself neither in the hospital ward nor in Jelena's room. Where she stays now is under heavy guard, with Hecate standing watch outside the door, appearing poised for any potential threat.
Where is Jelena? She has been by her side the whole time. How did she end up here?
Elvira's head spins with a familiar dizziness—the same kind she experienced during past kidnappings, causing the sharp noises around her to blend into an indistinct cacophony.

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Emergency alert! The Bureau's under attack! All non-combat personnel evacuate immediately!

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Repeat! The Bureau's under attack! All non-combat personnel MUST evacuate immediately! Attack location: Medical Wing!

steps.speaker: Alarm
steps.content: Warning! Sinner Jelena has broken containment!

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: ...Jelena?
